# The Rybak Firm, PLLC

> Brooklyn-based personal injury law firm with 25+ years of experience representing clients in accident, medical malpractice, and negligence claims across New York.

The Rybak Firm specializes in personal injury litigation, no-fault insurance disputes, and medical malpractice cases throughout New York and New Jersey. The firm is led by founder Oleg Rybak and a team of experienced trial attorneys with deep expertise in motor vehicle accidents, construction injuries, and healthcare liability claims.

## Key Topics

- personal injury law
- no-fault insurance
- medical malpractice
- negligence claims
- car accidents
- construction accidents
- slip and fall
- Brooklyn, NY
- New York trial lawyers

- OSHA violations

## Motor Vehicle & Transportation Accidents

- [Car accident lawyer NYC](https://rybakfirm.com/service/car-accident-lawyer): Auto accident legal services covering insurance disputes and negligence claims.
- [Rear end car accident New York](https://rybakfirm.com/service/rear-end-collision): Rear-end collision legal representation and fault determination services.
- [Pedestrian accident in New York](https://rybakfirm.com/service/nyc-pedestrian-accident-lawyer): Pedestrian accident legal services under NY Vehicle and Traffic Law.
- [Truck accident lawyers New York](https://rybakfirm.com/service/truck-accidents): Commercial truck accident legal services under FMCSA regulations.
- [Motorcycle Accident In New York](https://rybakfirm.com/service/motorcycle-accidents): Motorcycle accident legal services under NY no-fault insurance law.
- [New York Uber accident lawyer](https://rybakfirm.com/service/taxi-uber): Rideshare accident legal services for Uber, Lyft, and Via accidents.
- [Hit and run accident in New York](https://rybakfirm.com/service/hit-and-run): Hit-and-run accident legal guidance under NY Vehicle and Traffic Law Section 600.
- [Drunk Driving Accidents](https://rybakfirm.com/service/drunk-driving): Drunk driving accident legal representation and DWI negligence claims.

## Medical Malpractice & Healthcare Liability

- [Medical Malpractice](https://rybakfirm.com/service/medical-malpractice): Medical malpractice legal services for healthcare negligence claims.
- [Birth Injury](https://rybakfirm.com/service/birth-injury-attorneys): Birth injury legal services including Erb's Palsy and brachial plexus cases.
- [Pharmacy Malpractice](https://rybakfirm.com/service/pharmacy-malpractice): Pharmacy malpractice legal services for medication errors and healthcare liability.

## Workplace & Property Accidents

- [Construction accident lawyer NYC](https://rybakfirm.com/service/construction-accidents): Construction accident legal representation covering OSHA violations and workplace injuries.
- [Slip and fall lawyer New York](https://rybakfirm.com/service/slip-and-fall): Slip and fall accident legal services in NYC with contingency fee basis.

## Insurance & Specialized Claims

- [New York no fault law](https://rybakfirm.com/service/no-fault-litigation-and-arbitration): NY no-fault insurance law representation under Article 51 and ISC Section 5103.
